column3: With respect to the Hilton Tucson East Mortgage Loan (2.2%), the borrower has an outstanding COVID-19 Economic Injury Disaster Loan (“EIDL”) from the U.S. Small Business Administration in the amount of $138,000, secured by the related borrower’s personal property. At origination, the related borrower reserved funds equal to 125% of the full amount of the EIDL, which may be released to the borrower provided that no event of default is continuing and upon the lender’s satisfactory receipt of the confirmation that the EIDL has been repaid in full. The Mortgage Loan documents require the borrower to provide evidence reasonably satisfactory to the lender that the EIDL has been repaid in full by October 18, 2025.
